item.title: Cable wrangling
item.description:
Velcro or wire ties are acceptable for cable management.

⚠️ Twist ties, rubber bands, and tape are not acceptable for keeping cables or much else together.

Velcro

Velcro is preferred when cables will need to be lengthened or shortened often. If expense is not an issue Velcro is preferred for long-term cable storage to avoid issues with drying out and maximize reuse.

Wire ties

Wire ties are preferred where expense is a large concern. Tails must be clipped cleanly to avoid snags or cuts.

item.title: Software defined radio (SDR) links
item.description:
